name: @rally/game-kit
description: Client helpers every Rally game uses: PlayCanvas boot with a DPR cap, safe area, tap/drag input, direction keys, WebAudio unlock, host lifecycle (pause/resume/exit/lowMemory), optimistic-concurrency saves, frame metrics, snapshot interpolation, and the runtime half of the shared model pipeline (gzipped GLBs, pinned meshes, recolours, static batching, layered character anims).
